import React from 'react'

  fill: 'none',
  stroke: 'currentColor',
  strokeWidth: 1.7,
  strokeLinecap: 'round',
  strokeLinejoin: 'round',
}

function ringed(glyph, filled) {
  return filled
    ? (
      <>
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9.2" fill="currentColor" />
        <g fill="none" stroke="var(--fin-surface)" strokeWidth="1.9" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">{glyph}</g>

    )
    : (
      <>
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9.2" {...STROKE} />

}
